name: LPN-to-ADN Transition (A45110, accelerated bridge)
sourceWorkbook: Southeastern CC: ADN and LPN-to-ADN admission pages, the Nursing program page, the campus facilities list, the 2026–27 academic calendar, the NC Board of Nursing 2024 approved-programs list (max enrollment 140) and 2021–2023 pass rates; course hours, credits and sequence from the NCCCS A45110 standard — compiled 2026-10-28
maxCohortNote: Class size 20 within the Board's 140-student cap on the ADN program (the cohort joins the second-year courses) — derived at the owner's request (2026-10-28); the college publishes no class size and the inaugural Summer 2026 cohort's history is a single year.
weeklyHoursNote: Term hours per student are the catalog's weekly contact hours × 16 (the 16-week basis), whatever the term's length: the sessions carry them, the posted days, times and rooms place them. Hours and credits are the NCCCS course standard's; no section days, times or rooms are published, so every session carries its hours with no day or time; the summer term is the college's 10-week session (May 17 – Jul 27, 2027).

courses.title: Nursing Transition Concepts
courses.requisites: Admission to the LPN-to-ADN Transition (current unencumbered NC or compact LPN license, GPA ≥ 2.0, ATI Comprehensive Predictor)
courses.description: The bridge: concepts within the three domains of the individual, healthcare and nursing as the LPN moves to the RN role — evidence-based practice, quality improvement, communication, safety, the interdisciplinary team, informatics, assessment, clinical decision-making and professional behaviors. Completion carries the block credit for NUR 111, 112, 113 and 114 as the NCCCS transition design has it. Hours as the workspace's transition curriculum carries them (3-3-6); the college's own figure replaces them. Clinical on adult medical-surgical units. Hours and credits are the NCCCS standard's; the term placement is the standard's A45110 sequence — not yet confirmed against the college's catalog (unreachable 2026-10-28).

courses.description: Capstone: fluid/electrolytes, metabolism, perfusion, mobility, stress/coping, violence, health-wellness-illness, professional behaviors, caring interventions, managing care, healthcare systems and quality improvement; NCLEX-RN eligibility on completion. The 15-hour precepted practicum, 1:1 with an RN in an adult acute setting (medical-surgical or critical care). The LPN-to-ADN cohort joins the second-year class. Hours and credits are the NCCCS standard's; the term placement is the standard's A45110 sequence — not yet confirmed against the college's catalog (unreachable 2026-10-28).
